intro: *This feed is updated so players can quickly see what's changed.*

notes: MAJOR = breaking player-facing structure or progression resets.
MINOR = new features/content visible to players.
PATCH = fixes, balancing, and polish with no major feature rollout.
Optional -tag for pre-release or rollout labels.

player_update_criteria: Gameplay, progression, economy, or reward behavior changed.
Menus, UX flows, or social systems players directly use changed.
New or updated content/events/decor/recipes visible in game.
internal_update_criteria: Dev tooling, refactor, test harness, infra, or cleanup only.
No player-visible behavior change in normal gameplay.

pinned.label: Latest Update
pinned.summary: Your noodle shop has more to chase and more to show off: Achievements with claimable rewards, profile Badges, a customizable Daily Menu, plus weekly giveaways, work pings, counting milestones, and seasonal announcements in the Official Server.

changes: **Achievements** have arrived! Track 90 shop milestones across bowls served, gardening, fishing & foraging, blessings, quests, broth simmering, tipping, visitors, and more, then **claim your rewards** right from the Achievements menu (open it from your Stats menu or run `/noodle achievements`).
**Badge Customization** lets you show off your journey: open Customize menu → **Badges** to equip up to 7 badges each for Milestones, Achievements, and Collections on your profile.

**Daily Menu Customization** is here! Pick up to 10 learned recipes for your shop's order board menu from the new **Menu** button on the Orders Board. Select across multiple pages if you have a lot of recipes, then **Save Menu** (or cancel the draft). You can change your menu once per day after the daily reset.

**Weekly Giveaways** now run automatically in the Official Server every Wednesday: one to three contests, each open for a week, with prizes that include coins, coin packs, perks, and VALOR (official server xp). Tap **Enter Giveaway** for a chance to win, each player can win once per week.
A **Work Ping** now appears every two hours in the Official Server to remind you to use `/work` and earn VALOR (server xp).

The Official Server's **Counting Channel** is open: count with the community and reach special milestones to earn coins, REP, SXP, and recipe clues for your shop. A wrong number sends everyone back to 1, so count carefully!
Adjustments were made to shared orders: Shared orders limit how much one party member can contribute, so everyone gets a fair chance to help your party finish together.
Recipe wording updated, it now says **Discovered** to better match how you find new recipes.
Every major menu now feels more magical, with handmade banners that bring extra charm to your daily shop routine.
One-tap **Cook All** button is here to help you prep accepted orders in a breeze when the board gets busy.
Brand-new **Kitchen Line Minigame** is changing how you cook: keep the rhythm, manage the line, and serve better bowls to take control of your cooking quality.
Every **Shop Specialization** got a visual glow-up to show a richer mood and personality, from warm inn comfort to moonlit elegance.
If you are ready for a new shop story, revisit your specializations or stop by the Store to explore **premium specializations.**

**Known bug**: when using social features like tip, bless & contributing to shared orders, a private error saying 'Noodle Shop is thinking...' may appear. These messages can be dismissed and do not affect your gameplay.
New premium perks are now live: **24/7 House** helps you keep your shop rolling, and **Take Out Counter** lets you keep earning even while you're away.
3 new coin packs are available for players who want a fast boost and more freedom to upgrade their shop their way.
Official giveaways are live in the Official Server, with flexible prizes including server xp, perks, coin packs, and direct coin drops.
Takeout and discovery flows were polished to feel smoother and more consistent, so your progress feels better session after session.
Revamped **Bot List Vote Rewards** with cleaner vote links and direct button shortcuts to each active vote site.
Updated vote rewards layout to make claiming easier, including a clearer **Claim All Vote Rewards** flow.
Friendly reminder: each valid vote can grant **1,000c + 300 SXP + 50 REP**. If you vote regularly, rewards stack up quickly!
Added dedicated About & News menus with live counters for current servers & active noodle shops + a one-tap Join Support Server button.
Refined News layout to show **Latest Update**, **Previous Update**, then **Upcoming notes** & a **Seasonal Event Reminder**.
Expanded Seasonal lore & flavor in the **Season** menu.
Improved staff upgrade picker and embed readability for smoother staffing upgrades.
Enabled a notification for players once they reach 5000 REP: the **Seating** shop upgrade can unlock more orders on the order board.
6 **NEW** Premium Shop Specializations available for purchase in the store, each purchase includes **10,000c** for your shop.

sections.title: Upcoming Updates
items: **Recipe Creation** - design your own recipes and share them with your party.
**More Events & Minigames** - participate in limited-time events with unique recipes, bonuses, and challenges.
**Player Settings** - set your preferences for notifications, button display, and other gameplay options.
**Deeper Shop Customization** - more details to come!
